300.title: 'Now is the time': Donald Tusk pitches India-Poland partnership in new tech, defence for global markets
300.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called for India and Poland to move beyond traditional trade and build joint ventures in emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), digital products and space technology, as the two countries look to expand their presence in global markets.
300.body: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called for India and Poland to move beyond traditional trade and build joint ventures in emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), digital products and space technology, as the two countries look to expand their presence in global markets. Addressing the Global Investors Meet 2027 in Bengaluru on Friday, October 23, Tusk said companies from both countries could combine research capabilities, technology and capital to develop new products and take them to international markets. “Now it is time to translate these declarations into joint ventures,” Tusk said, making the case for closer commercial cooperation following the elevation of India-Poland ties to a strategic partnership. India and Poland look beyond traditional trade Tusk said partnerships between Indian and Polish companies could bring together research and development teams, technology and capital to develop digital products for international markets.

300.title: Polish space tech to hunt for the Moon’s richest resources
300.summary: The golden disc of the Moon during the full 'Sturgeon Moon', visible in a clear night sky (sko) PAP/Łukasz Gągulski A Polish company is developing a spectrometer designed to identify areas of the Moon richest in raw materials. The Polish spectrometer will help determine where to look for resources on the Moon.
300.body: The golden disc of the Moon during the full 'Sturgeon Moon', visible in a clear night sky (sko) PAP/Łukasz Gągulski A Polish company is developing a spectrometer designed to identify areas of the Moon richest in raw materials. The Polish spectrometer will help determine where to look for resources on the Moon. Polish startup MIRORES is responsible for the instrument, which will be part of the LUPE project, a mission to map the lunar surface in the mid- and far-infrared ranges. Within the LUPE consortium, the Polish company MIRORES – founded by engineers and scientists affiliated with institutions including the Polish Academy of Sciences, Wrocław University of Science and Technology and the University of Warsaw – is responsible for the mission's primary instrument: a mid- and far-infrared spectrometer.

500.title: Hackers hijack exposed AI models to launch cyberattacks at victims’ expense
500.summary: Sinisa Markovic , Managing Editor, Help Net Security October 23, 2026 Share Hackers hijack exposed AI models to launch cyberattacks at victims’ expense An attack tool built around AI goes looking for AI models that anyone on the internet can reach, then uses them to plan break-ins while the model’s owner pays for the computing power.
500.body: Sinisa Markovic , Managing Editor, Help Net Security October 23, 2026 Share Hackers hijack exposed AI models to launch cyberattacks at victims’ expense An attack tool built around AI goes looking for AI models that anyone on the internet can reach, then uses them to plan break-ins while the model’s owner pays for the computing power. What sets this tool apart, the researchers noted, is that “the stolen model does not simply answer questions; it plans and drives the attack.” “Once connected to an unprotected model, the agent is instructed to scan for new targets, exploit common web frameworks, steal databases and credentials, and quietly install cryptocurrency miners, for up to 100,000 steps and without asking a human for approval,” the researchers said. Targets include self-hosted model servers left open by default, AI gateways that front a company’s paid accounts, hastily deployed internal test systems and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect a model to tools.

600.title: Lech Poznan 1-1 Sunderland: Timur Tutierov's first Black Cats goal not enough as dominant visitors punished in Poland
600.summary: Timur Tutierov's first Sunderland goal was not enough to earn the victory they deserved in Poland as their wastefulness was punished in a 1-1 draw at lowly Lech Poznan.
600.body: Timur Tutierov's first Sunderland goal was not enough to earn the victory they deserved in Poland as their wastefulness was punished in a 1-1 draw at lowly Lech Poznan. The 21-year-old got the Black Cats' - and his own - night off to the perfect start with the fastest goal in this season's Europa League, nodding home Nilson Angulo's cross with barely a minute gone after Mateusz Lis' poor clearance was picked off. Tutierov spent last season on loan in League One with Exeter and was playing just his fourth game for Sunderland, having been fast-tracked into the club's first team following injuries to Brian Brobbey and Wilson Isidor. "The good news is that both Brobbey and Isidor are not far from a return, while Timur Tutierov's goal will do him the world of good after being thrown in at the deep end in his first Sunderland appearances - and finding life difficult."
